h1: Deployment pipelines for safe, automatic releases
overview: We set up a pipeline so that when your developers merge code, the tests run, the app is built and the release goes out without anyone typing commands on a server. We use GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or your own tool, add a manual approval step before production, and add a one-click rollback. Releases become routine, not risky evenings.

faq: Which CI tools do you support?
GitHub Actions and GitLab CI are our usual choices, and we also work with Bitbucket Pipelines, CircleCI and Jenkins. Tell us where your code lives and we choose the simplest fit.
Not required. The pipeline can run a build and lint check without tests. If you have none, we suggest a few starter checks, and our web app testing service can write real ones.
Can it deploy to my current servers?
Yes, to servers, containers, serverless functions or platforms such as Vercel and Render. We need to see how you deploy today, then automate those same steps.
The pipeline stops, tells you which step failed and leaves the live version untouched. From Standard up, one click returns to the last good release. We test this rollback before handover.
